_comment: acom-flex-bridge v0.2 configuration. Edit and restart.

serial._comment: COM port wired to the ACOM 700S *CAT/AUX* port (Kenwood CAT). Run 'npm run ports' to list ports. Match baud to the amp's CAT menu (usually 9600 8N1).

telemetry._comment: SECOND serial connection - to the amp's rear-panel *RS-232 remote* port (straight-through TX/RX/GND only; the bridge holds DTR/RTS low so the front-panel power button keeps working). measurementAddress: the ACOM protocol address byte of the measurement telegram - leave null for the first session, read the 'Frame addr=0x..' log lines, then set it (as decimal or 0x hex string is fine after JSON.parse; use decimal). measurementFieldOffset: byte offset of temp1 within that frame (default 8 per the protocol doc). logAllFrames: hex-log every frame, not just the first few per address.

flex._comment: IP of the FLEX-8400 (give it a DHCP reservation). enforceAtuBypass: keeps the radio's internal ATU in BYPASS at all times - mandatory with the amp + 06AT in line. Re-asserted at startup, before every tune, and whenever the ATU leaves bypass.

tune._comment: tunePowerDefault: carrier watts when the amp requests tune (06AT wants 12.5-50 W at the amp input; the amp asks for 20-30). followAmpPowerRequest: PC commands from the amp during tune override the default. maxTuneSeconds: safety carrier drop.

cat._comment: allowFreqWritesFromAmp false = amp frequency writes acked but dropped (kills the post-tune 0 Hz jump). minValidFreqHz: hard floor even if writes enabled. identity 019 = Kenwood TS-2000.

dashboard._comment: Web dashboard + live WebSocket at http://<host>:8990. user/password: optional login - blank password means no login prompt (fine for LAN-only). For access from anywhere, set credentials AND put HTTPS in front - see pi/README-PI.md 'Access from anywhere'. 5 failed logins = 5 minute per-IP lockout. When Caddy fronts the bridge on the same Pi, set host to 127.0.0.1 so only Caddy can reach it.

notify._comment: Optional outbound webhook fired when a tune completes/fails - leave blank if the dashboard is all you need. Any URL gets a JSON POST {event, text, freqHz, durationMs, finalSwr, ok}; ntfy.sh URLs get plain-text style automatically.

logging._comment: Keep 'debug' for the first capture sessions.
